date.source: The federation's own retrospective broadcast and a companion results post, both dated 5 October 1999.

matches.note: A no-rules brawl decided by placing the opponent in an ambulance; the loser had pre-signed a contract and a War Games berth, both won by the victor.

matches.stipulation: Prison Match, Hell in a Cell, GLHW Extreme Championship
matches.note: The federation's own first Extreme Championship match, fought inside a cage with weapon-loaded trash cans.
A fan-supplied-weapons brawl ending when the winner leaps from a balcony through a table onto his fallen opponent.

matches.stipulation: King of Hardcore, First Pinfall Wins
matches.note: A four-way hardcore brawl that spills through the arena, a backstage elevator and onto the roof, which gives way beneath two competitors before the pinfall is scored downstairs.

name: Thursday Night Warfare

date.source: The federation's own card, posted 21 October 1999.

matches.note: A ringside fan favorite's chair shot meant for the winner instead knocks out the loser, who is pinned moments later.
Both losing wrestlers ambush the winners after the bell, injuring one badly enough to require medical attention.

note: The preface notes two wrestlers withdrawn ahead of this card, one by his own handler and one for missing his assignments, leaving a bye in the federation's own Extreme Championship tournament.
